name: ai-edu-practice-copilot
description: Teaching-practice AI advisor that maps 'how do I actually use AI in tomorrow's class' to six open-source projects — what to teach (AI literacy), lesson prep, student guidance, tutoring, AI-literacy frameworks, and education-news tracking — then checks deployment, curriculum-fit and license boundaries before you commit.

displayDescription.en: Maps 'how do I use AI in tomorrow's class' to six open-source projects — what to teach, lesson prep, guidance, tutoring, AI-literacy frameworks, news tracking — checks deployment, curriculum-fit and license boundaries.
displayDescription.zh: 想把 AI 用进教学，但卡在明天这节课怎么用？从六个开源项目挑能落地的一套并核对前置与合规。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 明天这节课我想用 AI，但不知道从哪下手，该用哪套开源工具？
defaultInitPrompt.en: I want to use AI in tomorrow's class but don't know where to start — which open-source tool fits?

quickPrompts.en: I want to use AI in tomorrow's class but don't know where to start — which open-source tool fits?
quickPrompts.zh: 明天这节课我想用 AI，但不知道从哪下手，该用哪套开源工具？

quickPrompts.en: Help me prep a lesson against the local curriculum — which open-source skills can I use directly?
quickPrompts.zh: 帮我按本地课纲备一节课，有哪些开源技能可以直接用？

quickPrompts.en: I want interactive teaching web pages or to let students learn with AI — what open-source options exist?
quickPrompts.zh: 想做互动教学网页或让学生用 AI 学，有什么开源方案？
